## <a id="inseam_plugin_host_0_1_0"></a>Import interface inseam:plugin/host@0.1.0

Host capabilities, granted per the plugin's manifest. Calling a function
the manifest did not request (or whose budget is spent) returns an error
string; a well-behaved transform degrades to emitting less.

#### <a id="envelope"></a>`record envelope`

The envelope of the source under transformation.

  <p>Unix-epoch seconds.

- <a id="envelope.raw_bytes"></a>`raw-bytes`: `u64`

#### <a id="claim_spec"></a>`record claim-spec`

What this transform claims. The bridge intersects these with the
manifest's declared claims — the effective claim set is
`declared AND exported`, so a component cannot quietly widen its
reach past what its manifest promised.

##### Record Fields

- <a id="claim_spec.mimetypes"></a>`mimetypes`: list<`string`>
  <p>Mimetype essences (`image/png`) or `type/*` patterns.

- <a id="claim_spec.roots_only"></a>`roots-only`: `bool`
  <p>Claim source roots only, or emitted fragments too.


#### <a id="fragment"></a>`record fragment`

One emitted fragment. WIT has no recursive types, so the sprout tree
is flattened: `parent` indexes an EARLIER fragment in the same list,
and `none` hangs the fragment off the claimed fragment itself.

##### Record Fields

- <a id="fragment.parent"></a>`parent`: option<`u32`>
- <a id="fragment.mimetype"></a>`mimetype`: `string`
  <p>Mimetype of the emitted fragment, params allowed
  (`text/plain;via=ocr`).

- <a id="fragment.relation"></a>`relation`: `string`
  <p>Kind of the edge from the parent to this fragment, read
  parent -> child: the kernel's `contains` (structural child) or
  `derives` (derived understanding), or a kind this plugin defines
  (kebab-case, e.g. `transcribes`). Malformed names fall back to
  `contains`.

- <a id="fragment.text"></a>`text`: option<`string`>

#### <a id="apply"></a>`apply: func`

Transform one claimed fragment. Infallible by contract on the seam:
an error here is logged and treated as an empty output — indexing is
enrichment, and a broken transform must not gate the source.

##### Params

- <a id="apply.env"></a>`env`: [`envelope`](#envelope)
- <a id="apply.mimetype"></a>`mimetype`: `string`
- <a id="apply.is_root"></a>`is-root`: `bool`
- <a id="apply.text"></a>`text`: option<`string`>

##### Return values

- <a id="apply.0"></a> result<[`output`](#output), `string`>
